# Security reporting

This unreleased research capsule is intended to run local mathematical checks. It has no deployed service, credentials requirement, or supported production release.

Do not put credentials, private detector data, personal documents, or sensitive vulnerability details in public issues. Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/thequantumfalcon/homometric-photon-counts/security/advisories/new), which was enabled and verified on 2026-10-21.

Reports should include affected files, a concrete reproduction, expected impact, and a proposed mitigation if known. Generated claims without a reproducible demonstration are insufficient. Mathematical counterexamples and proof gaps belong in the scientific issue form unless they also expose a security issue.
